decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across dataset.row_count 9057, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe step is proposed.

ident has distinct_count 9057 and null_rate 0.0, exactly matching row_count 9057, making it the smallest defensible single-column grain; id and iata_code are equally unique but ident is the stable natural key reviewers can check against the warehouse.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata: true and are dropped; _airbyte_meta is constant ("{}") and _airbyte_extracted_at holds only two load timestamps.

scheduled_service has distinct_count 2 with distinct_values exactly "no" and "yes" and null_rate 0.0, so the two-value text is cast to BOOLEAN and renamed has_scheduled_service; any future third value would fail the cast and should surface in review.
elevation_ft lands as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample_value is integral (-1266.0 through -70.0) and the range min -1266.0 to max 14472.0 fits INTEGER.

latitude_deg (min -79.777778, max 82.517263) and longitude_deg (min -179.876999, max 179.9757) show at most six decimal places in every sample, so DECIMAL(38,9) is narrowed to DECIMAL(9,6) without loss on observed values.
home_link (null_rate 0.749034), keywords (0.679585) and local_code (0.636635) are sparsely populated but retained nullable; no imputation and no row filtering is applied.

id samples are integral ("10309", "1058") but ident, iata_code, icao_code, gps_code and local_code samples are alphanumeric ("03N", "0AA1"), so all identifier columns stay VARCHAR for consistent joining.

purpose: silver_ourairports_airports is the cleaned, one-row-per-airport reference table built from bronze.ourairports_airports (9057 rows), carrying identity codes, classification, location, and reference links for downstream geography and route dimensions.
usage: Join on ident, the declared grain; id and iata_code are equally unique in this snapshot and can serve as alternate keys. Read has_scheduled_service as a boolean derived from the source yes/no flag, and use latitude_deg and longitude_deg as DECIMAL(9,6) degrees. Consumers needing complete code coverage must handle nulls explicitly in icao_code, gps_code and local_code rather than assuming every airport carries each code.
limitations: No deduplication was applied because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 over 9057 rows; the grain on ident is asserted from distinct_count 9057 in this snapshot only and must be re-measured against the warehouse. Several columns are sparsely populated and were retained as-is: home_link (null_rate 0.749034), keywords (0.679585), local_code (0.636635), icao_code (0.136579), wikipedia_link (0.130838), gps_code (0.053881), municipality (0.039748) and elevation_ft (0.036988). Coordinates and elevation were narrowed based on only 10 sampled values per column plus min/max, so an out-of-pattern value would fail the cast; keywords remains unparsed free text.
